question: Where can I find a fast food restaurant no more than 100 kilometers away to the southeast of Indian Run Falls Park - Observation Deck B, Dublin, OH?
sql:
WITH origin AS  (SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.120136 40.100971)',4326)::geography AS geometry)
SELECT * FROM pois, origin
WHERE ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.120136 40.100971)',4326)::geography, 100000)
AND amenity = 'fast_food'
AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 112.5 AND 157.5;

[3].display_name: Indian Run Falls Park - Observation Deck B, Dublin, OH

poi.poi_name: Indian Run Falls Park - Observation Deck B
